items.title: Katie Zacharia Was Linked to an AI Rare-Earths Startup. It’s Even Weirder Than It Sounds
items.summary: The short-lived White House press secretary was listed as an adviser to a Kristi Noem–linked company that aims to use AI for mining. Both the company and she say she never worked there.
items.author: Tess Owen, Tim Marchman

items.title: Maybe Chatbots Shouldn’t Get to Say ‘I’ or ‘Me’
items.summary: MIT professor Sherry Turkle warns that people have become dangerously enmeshed with chatbots.
items.author: Steven Levy

items.title: AI-Generated Hot Girls Are Ripping Off Comedians to Boost Their Horny Content
items.summary: A network of AI-generated models is using comics’ material to funnel views to their OnlyFans and Fanvue accounts—and there’s not much comedians can do about it.
items.author: Ej Dickson
